point: {"time": T, "price": P} or {"time": T, "snap": "open"|"high"|"low"|"close"}. T is unix seconds, unix milliseconds or an ISO 8601 date or date-time (UTC unless it has an offset); it resolves to the bar containing it. snap takes that bar's value.

style.fill: fill color, as color; may carry alpha

tools.label: Ray
tools.name: rayLine
points: a point it passes through, after which it runs on to the edge
tools.summary: A line from the first point through the second, extended past it.

tools.label: Extended line
tools.name: straightLine
tools.summary: A line through two points, extended both ways.

tools.label: Horizontal line
tools.name: horizontalStraightLine
points: the price level (its time only places the handle)
tools.summary: A horizontal line across the whole chart.

tools.label: Horizontal ray
tools.name: horizontalRayLine
points: origin; the ray runs right from it at its price
tools.summary: A horizontal line from a point to the right edge.

tools.label: Vertical line
tools.name: verticalStraightLine
points: the bar (its price only places the handle)
tools.summary: A vertical line at a bar.

tools.label: Parallel channel
tools.name: parallelStraightLine
points: first point of the base line
second point of the base line
a point the parallel line passes through
tools.summary: Two parallel lines across the whole chart.

tools.label: Fib retracement
tools.name: fibonacciLine
tools.summary: Levels at 0, 23.6, 38.2, 50, 61.8, 78.6 and 100% between two prices, across the whole chart, each labelled with its price.

tools.label: Rectangle
tools.name: cgRect
tools.summary: A filled rectangle, e.g. a support or resistance zone.

tools.label: Text annotation
tools.name: cgText
points: where the text starts (its left edge, vertically centred)

tools.label: Price label
tools.name: simpleTag
points: the price (its time only places the handle)
tools.summary: A dashed line across the chart with its price on the right.

tools.label: Pitchfork
tools.name: cgPitchfork
tools.summary: Andrews' pitchfork: a median line from P1 through the middle of P2-P3, and parallels through P2 and P3, to the edge.

tools.label: Price range
tools.name: cgPriceRange
tools.summary: A band between two prices, labelled with the change and its percentage.

tools.label: Date range
tools.name: cgDateRange
tools.summary: A band between two times, labelled with the bars and the time between them.

tools.label: Date and price range
tools.name: cgDatePriceRange
tools.summary: A box between two points, labelled with the price change and the time between them.

tools.label: Long position
tools.name: cgLong
points: entry; its time is the box's left edge
target, above the entry; its time is the box's right edge
stop, below the entry; the same time as the target
tools.summary: A long position: a green target zone above the entry, a red stop zone below it, and the risk/reward ratio.

tools.label: Short position
tools.name: cgShort
points: entry; its time is the box's left edge
target, below the entry; its time is the box's right edge
stop, above the entry; the same time as the target
tools.summary: A short position: a green target zone below the entry, a red stop zone above it, and the risk/reward ratio.
